title: Quick-Fix Winey Kenyan Beef Agemono
description: A quick and flavorful Kenyan-inspired dish featuring beef flank steak, deep-fried in a spicy wine marinade. Jain-friendly by omitting onions and garlic.

ingredients.name: red wine
ingredients.notes: full-bodied, such as Cabernet or Merlot

instructions: Cut the beef flank steak into thin strips and season with salt, black pepper, garam masala, coriander powder, and cumin powder.
In a large bowl, whisk together red wine, grain vinegar, and 1 tablespoon of corn oil to make the marinade.
Add the beef strips to the marinade and mix well to coat.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or up to 2 hours.
Heat the remaining 1/2 cup of corn oil in a deep frying pan to 375°F (190°C).
Dredge the marinated beef strips in flour, shaking off excess.
Deep-fry the beef strips in batches until golden brown and cooked through, about 3-4 minutes per batch.
Using a slotted spoon, remove the fried beef from the oil and place on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Repeat with the remaining beef strips.
Serve the Quick-Fix Winey Kenyan Beef Agemono hot and enjoy!
Serve immediately and garnish with fresh cilantro or scallions, if desired.
